title: Compact incoming replay checks deferred planning entries as strictly as the full reducer
outcome: Compact incoming replay checks deferred planning entries as strictly as the full reducer
acceptance: A malformed historical PlanningDeferred entry (empty, duplicate or unsorted claims, or a foreign or backward after_cut) is refused by compact incoming replay exactly when the full reducer and doctor refuse it, through one shared predicate.
A behavior test feeds the malformed fixtures to both paths and shows the same outcome.
